sources.publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment / National Career Service, disseminated by PIB
sources.dataset_name: NCS active vacancies: State/UT Annexure, as of 14 July 2025
sources.license: PIB attribution/reproduction policy; not a blanket GODL/CC licence
sources.geography: India; published State/UT, multiple-state and unspecified buckets
sources.granularity: Administrative active-vacancy stock as of 14 July 2025; no occupation/skill/industry breakdown
sources.methodology: Published NCS portal active vacancies; stock at a point in time, not annual vacancies mobilised, final hiring, unique jobs or a national census of demand
sources.notes: Portal/partner coverage and duplicate/repost treatment not quantified. Historical DNH/Daman&Diu labels remain unassigned; dash is unavailable; multiple states and unspecified location are not distributed. No district or occupation/skill/sector observations. Historical snapshot, not real-time.
sources.access_method: Explicit HTTPS download of public PIB Annexure HTML
sources.update_frequency: Ad-hoc parliamentary release; no guaranteed feed

sources.dataset_name: NIC2008 Codes & Descriptions, Sixth Economic Census reference
sources.license: Public official classification, MoSPI open-access terms with attribution; no blanket CC/GODL
sources.methodology: Preserve official codes as strings and source hierarchy
sources.notes: Partial Sixth Economic Census listing: 19 sections, 82 divisions, 231 groups; Division02 absent; no classes/subclasses. Historical PLFS alignment; NIC2025 exists. Taxonomy is not demand. No invented crosswalk.
sources.access_method: Explicit HTTPS snapshot download; offline parsing
sources.update_frequency: Fixed version snapshot; source releases may be annual or irregular

sources.notes: FY2026-27 partial to30June2026; certifications may concern prior cohorts, not a conversion rate. Lakshadweep absent. FY2024-25 national trained total quarantined: published2038319 versus state sum2038199 (difference120). No seats/capacity/placement/demand measures.
sources.access_method: Explicit HTTPS snapshot download; offline parsing
sources.update_frequency: Fixed version snapshot; source releases may be annual or irregular

sources.dataset_name: Skilling for Space and Geospatial Sectors — Annexure II PMKVY training centres
sources.geography: 36 published State/UT rows; no national total
sources.methodology: Published administrative training-centre stock as of 30 June 2026; no seats or throughput inferred
sources.notes: Infrastructure count, not current capacity or available workers. Andhra Pradesh 527 includes 6 in Konaseema per source footnote. NAPS establishments and sector trainees not ingested. No district allocation or national total.
sources.access_method: Explicit HTTPS snapshot download; offline parsing
sources.update_frequency: Fixed version snapshot; source releases may be annual or irregular
